narrative.intro: Reed Technology and Information Services has $218M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Reed Technology and Information Services received 1 award so far this fiscal year with an average award size of $218M. Reed Technology and Information Services obligations are up 27.0% year over year. Reed Technology and Information Services has a multi-year record of federal obligations that shows fiscal-year totals of $175M in FY21, $185M in FY22, $198M in FY23, $199M in FY24, $172M in FY25, and $218M in FY26. Reed Technology and Information Services current-year totals are partial, covering the fiscal year to date. Reed Technology and Information Services shows a single large award driving the FY2026 total, and the company’s historical totals provide context for that concentration.
